Name: Abigail face tweak
Author: jackablade
Description:
Just a quick mod to test out the viability of making some changes to the appearance of the in game sprites - I'm not a particular fan of the big eyes and no jaw look. I worked on Abigail as a test. Tweaked the head and eye shapes and messed with the shading a little.

The sprite tweaks are so quick that I'll probably do a few more. I've got no idea whether this is something that others are going to want, but it's here if you want it. *shrug*

Downloads.Description: Changes Abigail's face to something a smidgen more realistic
